question: Snake Boat Race is related to which of the following festival?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Onam, Kerala. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Snake Boat Race**

 
 
• ​Snake Boat Race is also known as **Nehru Trophy Boat Race.**
 
• The name of the water race was coined following **Jawaharlal Nehru**’s visit to Kerala in 1952.
 
• This race festival is held in Alappuzha, Kerala, and is held just **before the Onam festival.** 
 
• Nehru Trophy Boat Race, held on the second Saturday of August every year at Punnamda Lake near Alappuzha lies on the banks of the river Pampa.
 
• In this game, boats that are nearly 100 feet long compete against one another to the tunes of old folk songs.**​​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• Snake Boat Race is the **Largest** and only sport in the world in which more than 100 people participate in a team.
 
• In this game, each boat belongs to a village and the villagers worship the boat like a deity. 
 
• Snake boat race festival is a sport that signifies **Team-Spirit,** Integration, and the Amity of the people of the backwaters of Kerala.
 
• Nehru Trophy boat race to be held in **UAE **on **March 2022** in partnership with International Marine Sports Club Ras Al Khaimah and TheBrew Media FZC LLC, at the Al Marjan Island.
